title: Residential Electricity Supply Customer Agreement: Changing Plans Mid-Term
content:
**Article 1 (Permission).** A customer may move an active Residential Electricity Supply agreement to another Beacon Ridge residential electricity plan when the current plan permits a mid-term plan change. A plan change is made only on an active agreement, as shown by the agreement's status.

**Article 2 (Term of the new plan).** A mid-term plan change is allowed only to a plan whose term in months is equal to or longer than the current plan's term, except within the current plan's fee-free window before the contract end date, when any plan may be chosen. Moving from a month-to-month plan to any fixed plan is always allowed.

**Article 3 (Eligibility).** The new plan must satisfy the enrollment eligibility rules for the premise and the customer.

**Article 4 (Fee).** An allowed plan change carries no early termination fee when the current plan waives the fee on a move to a plan with an equal or longer term.

**Article 5 (Credits).** A plan change earns no sign-up credit, no online enrollment credit and no renewal loyalty credit.

**Article 6 (Retired).** The former clause "The change takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle per the plan change effective basis, at the offer rate of the price offer for the new plan and the premise's electric utility valid on that date, and the new term is counted from the plan change date." is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current Residential Electricity Supply basis for when a plan change takes effect and the rate at which it is made.

## Article 2 applied (hypothetical agreements)

| Current plan | Requested plan | Within the current plan's fee-free window | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | no | yes, longer term |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | no | yes, equal term |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | no | no, shorter term |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | yes | yes, any plan within the window |
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | not applicable | yes, month-to-month to fixed |

A requested plan that passes Article 2 must still be one the premise and customer could enroll in; for example, Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 still needs an AMI smart meter at the premise.

superseded_clauses: The change takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle per plan_change_effective_basis, at the offer_rate of the price offer for the new plan and the premise's electric utility valid on that date, and the new term is counted from plan_change_date.
